changeSet.sql: with aktuell as ( select inhalt from konfiguration_version order by version desc limit 1 ), ki as ( select jsonb_build_object( 'rolle', rolle, 'feldregeln', feldregeln, 'kiFreigegeben', ki_freigegeben) as inhalt from ki_texte where id = 1 ), naechste as ( select coalesce(max(version), 0) + 1 as version from konfiguration_version ), abbild as ( select n.version, jsonb_set(a.inhalt - 'kiTexte', '{version}', to_jsonb(n.version), true) || jsonb_build_object('kiTexte', ki.inhalt) as inhalt from aktuell a cross join ki cross join naechste n ) insert into konfiguration_version (version, wer, grund, quelle, inhalt, sha256) select version, 'system:migration', null, 'MIGRATION', inhalt, encode(sha256(convert_to(inhalt::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') from abbild where (inhalt - 'version') is distinct from ( select inhalt - 'version' from konfiguration_version order by version desc limit 1);
